Name: Renew and Auto-Renew Public Wildcard SSL and Internal CA Certificates
Description:
Owner: Ben
Deadline: August 22nd (before September 1st expiry for public cert; internal CA cert expires ~September 15th)

Background: The wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com expires on September 1st. In the same change window, the internal CA cert that signs the service mesh must also be rotated; it expires two weeks after the public one. Currently these certs are renewed manually each year, which we want to eliminate.

Steps to reproduce / perform:
1. Renew the wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com.
2. Deploy the renewed public cert to the load balancers.
3. Move the public cert onto cert-manager so it auto-renews going forward.
4. Within the same change window, rotate the internal CA cert that signs the service mesh.
5. Move the internal CA cert onto cert-manager so it also auto-renews going forward.
6. Perform both cert changes in one change window.

Acceptance criteria:
- Wildcard SSL cert for api.ourapp.com is renewed and deployed to load balancers by August 22nd.
- Internal CA cert for the service mesh is rotated in the same window.
- Both certificates are managed by cert-manager with auto-renewal enabled.
- No manual renewal required for future cycles.

Name: PDF Export Feature for Reports (including demo GIF)
Description:
Owner: Aisha
Deadline: End of month

Background: Customers have repeatedly requested the ability to export reports as PDFs. Aisha scoped the work last week. It is one deliverable with two halves (backend and frontend) that Aisha will handle entirely to avoid splitting the work.

Scope:
- Backend: Render the report to PDF using headless Chrome.
- Frontend: Add an export button and a progress/loading state, since large reports take a few seconds to render.
- Marketing deliverable: Record a short demo GIF for the changelog as part of finishing the feature. This is folded into the same task, not a separate item.

Steps to reproduce / perform:
1. Implement backend PDF rendering of reports using headless Chrome.
2. Add an export button to the report UI.
3. Add a progress state to the UI for large report exports that take a few seconds.
4. Test export across various report sizes to verify progress state and output.
5. Record a short demo GIF of the export feature for the changelog.
6. Provide the demo GIF to marketing.

Acceptance criteria:
- Users can click an export button on reports to generate a PDF.
- A progress/loading state is shown while the PDF is being generated.
- Large reports render correctly to PDF via headless Chrome.
- A short demo GIF is recorded and available for the changelog.
- Feature is completed by end of month.

Name: Staging Environment Parity: Run Pending Migrations and Add Schema Drift Monitoring
Description:
Owner: Ben
Deadline: Run three pending migrations today; nightly diff job to be set up (no hard date specified)

Background: The staging environment is three migrations behind production, which continues to burn QA time. We need to both catch staging up and prevent future drift.

Steps to reproduce / perform:
1. Run the three pending migrations on staging today to bring it to parity with production.
2. Write a nightly job that diffs the staging schema against the production schema.
3. Configure the job to post a notification to the infra channel if staging and production schemas diverge.
4. Verify the nightly job runs and posts correctly.

Acceptance criteria:
- The three pending migrations are applied to staging today.
- Staging schema matches production after migrations.
- A nightly job is in place that diffs staging schema against production.
- The job posts to the infra channel when divergence is detected.
- Future schema drift between staging and production is caught and reported automatically.
